skill.name: cc-devflow-orchestrator
skill.description: Routes CC-DevFlow users to the right workflow command, agent, and phase gate for requirements, design, development, QA, and release.
skill.summary: Route CC-DevFlow work from roadmap planning through release with command and agent recommendations.
skill.author: Dimon94

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks around workflow maps, file references, and CC-DevFlow slash-command names. Three lines recommend running local .claude/scripts shell helpers; those fixed paths are workflow-related but still require review before execution. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or malicious social engineering was found.

remediation.suggestion: Add an explicit confirmation step before running .claude/scripts helpers, and tell users to inspect each script first.

remediation.issue: Markdown command examples trigger shell-execution scanners
remediation.suggestion: Label slash-command examples as CC-DevFlow commands, not shell commands, and avoid unnecessary inline backticks where possible.

static_findings.snippet: - `/flow-init` 包含 Brainstorming 阶段,生成 BRAINSTORM.md 作为需求「北极星」
- `/flow-prd` 需要 BRAINSTORM.md 对齐检查
- `/flow-clarify` 在 PRD 前可选执行,消除 research.md 中的歧义
- `/flow-epic` 使用 bite-sized tasks 原则 (2-5分钟/任务)
- `/flow-dev` 默认 Autonomous 模式(自动重试),使用 `--manual` 退出到 Manual 模式
- `/flow-review` 是新增的两阶段审查 (Spec Compliance → Code Quality)
- `/flow-ui` 和 `/flow-dev` 自动加载 `devflow/STYLE.md`(如存在)
- **DO**: Recommend `/flow-qa` command → invokes qa-tester + security-reviewer agents
- **DO**: Recommend `/flow-review` command → invokes spec-reviewer + code-quality-reviewer agents
- `/flow-fix "BUG-123|登录超时"` - 系统化 BUG 修复 (4阶段调试法)
**Rationale**: Avoid duplication ("不重不漏" principle). Agents and Commands own detailed standards.

content.value_statement: Complex CC-DevFlow projects need clear routing between requirements, design, development, review, QA, and release. This skill recommends the next command, agent, and gate based on workflow status.
actual_capabilities: Maps project-level commands for roadmap, architecture, guidelines, and style setup.
Routes requirement phases from flow-init through release and verification.
Recommends agents for PRD, technical design, UI, planning, QA, and review.
Summarizes entry and exit gates for each CC-DevFlow phase.
Provides troubleshooting routes for blocked gates, missing documents, and TDD issues.
Lists auxiliary commands for status, upgrades, bug fixes, and code review.
limitations: It does not contain full command, agent, or constitution standards.
It depends on the wider CC-DevFlow command and agent files being present.
It does not execute commands or validate project state by itself.
Some guidance references local helper scripts that require review before execution.

use_cases.title: Start a New Project Flow
use_cases.description: Choose the project-level setup commands for roadmap, architecture, guidelines, and design style before requirement work begins.

use_cases.title: Recover a Blocked Requirement
use_cases.description: Identify the current phase, missing document, or gate failure, then select the next CC-DevFlow action.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Review and QA
use_cases.description: Route completed development through spec review, code quality review, QA, security checks, release, and verification.

prompt_templates.title: Find My Next Step
prompt_templates.prompt: I am new to CC-DevFlow. Ask me for my current phase and recommend the next workflow command.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Requirement Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide a requirement from research to PRD, technical design, task planning, and development. Include required gates.

prompt_templates.title: Recover From a Blocked Gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the orchestrator to diagnose a blocked CC-DevFlow phase. Explain which status, document, or agent I should check.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Advanced Routing Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate whether to run review, QA, release, or verification for this requirement state. Include tradeoffs and gate risks.

output_examples.input: The PRD is complete, and I need the next CC-DevFlow action.
output_examples.output: Recommend the technical design phase first. UI prototyping can run after PRD completion, but task planning should wait for design context.

output_examples.input: Development is complete, but QA has not started.
output_examples.output: Recommend the two-stage review before QA. Explain that QA can run after review completion or directly if review is intentionally skipped.

output_examples.input: A requirement is blocked because a document is missing.
output_examples.output: Ask for the current orchestration status, identify the incomplete phase, and direct the user to the relevant command or agent reference.

best_practices: Confirm the current orchestration status before choosing a command.
Review linked command and agent files for detailed standards.
Treat local script execution as optional until the user approves it.
anti_patterns: Do not copy detailed agent standards into the orchestrator response.
Do not skip phase gates when required documents are missing.
Do not run referenced shell scripts without checking their source and purpose.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It routes CC-DevFlow users to the right command, agent, and phase gate for their current workflow state.

faq.question: Does it replace the detailed agents?
faq.answer: No. It points to the agent or command that owns the detailed execution standard.

faq.question: Can it help with project setup?
faq.answer: Yes. It lists project-level commands for roadmap, architecture, guidelines, and style setup.

faq.question: Can it help after development is done?
faq.answer: Yes. It routes users through review, QA, release, and final verification steps.

faq.question: Does it run shell scripts automatically?
faq.answer: No. It references helper scripts for troubleshooting, but users should inspect and approve them first.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
